summary: Iter 95a backend-only testing. All three scoped items verified: (1) Weekly Review dedupe now stores/returns a real Mongo UUID in review.video_task_id (never the literal 'existing') and is idempotent across repeated checkin/progress complete calls; (2) new Dual-Session module (/api/dual-session/today, /upcoming, /debug/{user_id}) works end-to-end with proper flag gating and coach-only access (403 for client, 200 for coach); (3) feature_flag dual_session_enabled toggle via /api/admin/app-config correctly disables the feature client-side. testcal2@crewfit.com (mixed) returns 200 without any 500. weekly-review/current still returns the aggregated training/nutrition/habits/message_lines/coach payload. No duplicate weekly_video_review coach tasks for same user+week. 20/20 tests passing (11 endpoint + 9 unit).

minor.issue: Benign asyncio 'cannot schedule new futures after interpreter shutdown' warning printed at teardown because importing feature_dual_session pulls in server → feature_app_config._seed_defaults_once as a background task that survives pytest exit. Tests still exit 0 and all assertions pass. Non-blocking, worth silencing later by lazy-importing db in the unit test or using pytest-asyncio session-scoped teardown.

action_items: (Optional/minor) Suppress the interpreter-shutdown warning in test_iter95a.py by not triggering server import at collection time, or by using a fixture that shields _seed_defaults_once from being scheduled during unit-only runs.
(Optional/minor) Consider adding a testID-friendly frontend surface for the Optional Activation nudge once wired up on Home — outside this backend-only scope.
critical_code_review_comments: feature_dual_session.py — `_load_flag` treats an app_config doc without a 'value' key as falsy (returns bool(None)=False) instead of the documented 'default TRUE per seed'. The default-TRUE only applies when the doc is missing entirely. Not a functional issue today because the seed inserts value=true, but if an admin ever DELETEs the doc via /admin/app-config/{key} soft-disable (which sets enabled=false but keeps value), _load_flag still reads value truthily — consistent. Just worth noting the branch: `if not doc: return True` then `return bool(v)` — a doc with value:null would be treated as disabled. Fine for now.

feature_dual_session.py — `_roster_days_for_user` fetches rosters without filtering by status ('active'), so a stale/archived roster could shadow the active one. In today's data this returns identical days across rosters. Consider filtering `status: 'active'` for consistency with `_roster_summary` in feature_weekly_review.py.

feature_weekly_review.py `_maybe_create_video_task` — dedupe logic is solid: (1) reuse stored id if it still exists, (2) adopt any live task for same user+week+task_type, (3) create fresh + persist. Idempotency verified by test — same UUID on repeated check-in/progress complete calls.
server.py has grown very large (>7500 lines by grep offsets). Long-term maintainability concern; not in scope for Iter 95a.
